useWhen: One disclosure whose body composes kit pieces
Product details or extra spec the user can hide
doNotUseWhen: Two or more related sections, one open at a time — use Accordion

children.note: Revealed body. Compose kit pieces, never a local cousin

requirements: Trigger is a button with aria-expanded
Panel is role=region, aria-labelledby the button
Closed panel is hidden from AT

doNot: Do not invent CollapsibleTrigger or CollapsibleContent cousins
Do not use Accordion for a single block
